_comment: Transcribed from an in-game screenshot taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture index 113 in the 16:03 run). Gadget screens carry a name, a model designation and a description but no stat block or trait chips, so this item has no stats or ratings. Art is cropped from the same shot. The page leads with the model designation because that is what EA's patch notes use.
name: MP-APS

description.text: Once set on the ground, this device tracks and destroys larger incoming projectiles such as missiles, mortar shells, and tank shells. Can intercept up to three projectiles during a window of activation that begins after the initial detection.
